specimen: 1968 early silverface Twin Reverb, documented JBL D120F factory option; RetroFret A-13834 is a photographic reference, not authority for standard equipment

cabinet.basis: Dealer lists 26 1/4 W x 20 H x 10 1/4 D inches. Reported specimen dimensions, not independently measured. Treating height as cabinet body is a photographic interpretation; caster/handle inclusion is unresolved.
cabinet.status: Provisional specimen envelope retained pending reconciliation with period catalog. Not a verified factory dimension.

estimates.note: All subdimensions above are photographic modeling estimates; 12-inch speaker designation is nominal, not a measured 304.8 mm frame. No claim of independently verified mounting geometry.

knob.basis: Exported from the actual shared component builder; exterior dimensions remain estimates. User accepted appearance for now.

configuration.target: Fender period production configuration with documented JBL speaker option
configuration.casters: Excluded: present on dealer specimen, but factory installation in 1968 is not established. Do not infer aftermarket installation either.
configuration.speakers: JBL D120F factory option, not standard fitment

factoryEvidence.type: 1968 Fender catalog scan, specifications; scan leaf 32 / printed page 30
factoryEvidence.supports: Two 12-inch speakers, JBL D120F extra-cost option, tilt-back legs. Lists dimensions differing from dealer specimen.

factoryEvidence.type: 1968 Fender catalog scan, product photograph; scan leaf 33 / printed page 31
factoryEvidence.supports: Twin shown without casters. Catalog photography is period factory evidence, not a manufacturing drawing.

corroboration.supports: Lists glides for 1968–71 and casters for 1972–82; corroboration, not primary proof of every production change.

photographicReference.limits: Dealer originality attribution is not independent proof of factory equipment. Casters excluded from factory baseline.

catalogDimensions.basis: 1968 Fender catalog scan lists 26 1/2 W × 20 1/2 H × 9 3/4 D inches. Published dimensions, not caliper measurements; catalog photographs/specifications may span a transition.
catalogDimensions.status: Conflict with dealer-reported specimen envelope remains unresolved. Do not silently average or treat either as verified construction dimensions.
